about: Parker Waichman LLP is a personal injury and mass tort firm with seven offices. Its headquarters is in Port Washington, New York, with further locations in Manhattan, Brooklyn, Forest Hills and Melville, and outside the state in West Orange, New Jersey and Bonita Springs, Florida.
The firm states that it charges a contingency fee, meaning it is not paid unless the case recovers. It publishes a free consultation, a 24-hour intake line and service in English and Spanish.
